lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are distributed across the mid-section of the visible flank. A primary grouping of approximately 8-10 blobs forms a sparse grid, with a more concentrated cluster located anterior to the second dorsal fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Intermittent vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a visible grid-like configuration in the central and posterior regions of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature with a sharp vertical gradient—characterized by high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and low-intensity pixels on the ventral side—extends across the upper third of the visible flank.
